description: A self-contained publishing system for stories, essays, poetry, articles, and how-tos. Features an admin panel for content management, dynamic filtering on the index page, series grouping with collapse/expand, and automatic HTML generation with reading time calculation.
author: Tim Samoff

architecture.type: Static site with local server for saving

root.name: index.html
root.description: Main index page with table of contents, filter system, and series grouping

root.name: style.css
root.description: Global styles with dark/light theme, typography, and responsive design

root.name: theme.js
root.description: Universal theme switcher, reading time calculator, and scroll progress bar

root.name: index.js
root.description: Index page logic: loads projects, renders table with series grouping, handles expand/collapse

root.name: filter-system.js
root.description: Multi-category filtering for genres and themes on the index page

root.name: data.js
root.description: Auto-generated project data (projects.json) - DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

admin.name: admin.html
admin.description: Admin panel interface with 50/50 split layout: form on left, sortable list on right

admin.name: admin.js
admin.description: Complete admin logic: CRUD operations, series management, HTML generation, image path fixing

admin.name: admin.css
admin.description: Admin panel styles with scrollbars, form inputs, tag manager, and responsive design

templates.name: template.html
templates.description: Base HTML template used by admin to generate article pages

data.name: projects.json
data.description: Central data store containing projects, genres, themes, and series

index_page.table_of_contents: Displays all published projects grouped by series
index_page.series_grouping: Series are collapsed by default with toggle icon
index_page.filter_system: Multi-select filtering by genre and theme with collapsible panel
index_page.date_range: Series show date range on two lines (e.g., 'May 20 –' / 'June 4, 2026')
index_page.part_badge: Shows 'Part X' badge for series articles
index_page.responsive: Adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop

article_page.dynamic_reading_time: Calculated from word count (200 words per minute)
article_page.series_nav: Previous/Next navigation in sidebar with vertical layout
article_page.scroll_progress: Progress bar at top of page
article_page.responsive: Adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop

admin_panel.split_layout: Form on left (50%), sortable list on right (50%)
admin_panel.tag_management: Add/remove genres and themes with autocomplete
admin_panel.series_management: Create, edit, delete series with modal dialogs
admin_panel.search: Filter pieces by title, slug, or path
admin_panel.preview: Preview article in new tab with absolute image paths
admin_panel.image_path_fixing: Automatic relative/absolute path conversion for images

theme_system.dark_mode: Dark and light themes with CSS variables

endpoints.GET /api/projects: Returns all projects, genres, themes, and series
endpoints.POST /api/save-projects: Saves projects, genres, themes, and series to projects.json
endpoints.POST /api/save-html: Saves HTML file to the writing directory

admin.js.extractArticleContent(html): Extracts inner content and line-height class from article tag
admin.js.fixImagePaths(html, project, context): Fixes image paths for 'save' (relative) or 'preview' (absolute) contexts
admin.js.renderList(): Renders sortable list with series grouping
admin.js.addGenre() / addTheme(): Adds new genre or theme to the system

index.js.renderTable(projects, series): Renders TOC with series grouping and expand/collapse
index.js.createRow(project, isSeries, isExpanded,: Creates table row for a project
index.js.applyDefaultSeriesState(): Sets all series to collapsed by default
index.js.updateFilterButtons(): Dynamically creates filter buttons from genres and themes

filter-system.js.initFilterSystem(): Initializes filter system with collapsible panel
filter-system.js.matchesFilters(row): Checks if a row matches active genre/theme filters
filter-system.js.updateDisplay(): Updates visibility of rows based on filters
filter-system.js.clearAllFilters(): Resets all filters to show everything

theme.js.reading time: Calculates reading time from .story-content and appends to .card-meta
theme.js.scroll progress: Tracks scroll position and updates progress bar

known_issues_fixed.line_height: Template no longer has hardcoded article tag; content provides its own with correct ls-* class
known_issues_fixed.series_nav: Added sidebar back to template; nav uses relative filenames with vertical layout
known_issues_fixed.reading_time: Reading time appended to card-meta with duplicate prevention
known_issues_fixed.date_and_title: Placeholders replaced in correct order by admin
known_issues_fixed.image_paths: fixImagePaths handles relative/absolute conversion for save and preview contexts
known_issues_fixed.series_filtering: Series articles inherit genres/themes from series for filtering

future_improvements.export_options: PDF, ePub, and other export formats
